advisor_identified: Frank R. Chalk, professor of history at Concordia University and co-supervisor of Christopher John Young’s thesis on Western interference in Haiti.

doctorate.title: The United States and the International Struggle for Rubber, 1914-1941

evidence.says: The History faculty list, p. 282, lists professor Frank R. Chalk with a PhD from the University of Wisconsin–Madison.
UW–Madison Libraries catalogues The United States and the international struggle for rubber, 1914-1941 by Frank Robert Chalk and identifies it as a PhD thesis, University of Wisconsin–Madison, 1970.
CiNii Books independently catalogues the same title by Frank Robert Chalk; its thesis note identifies a PhD at the University of Wisconsin in 1970.

Christopher John Young’s Plus ça change… A Historical Survey of Western Interference in Haiti names Frank Chalk and Carolyn Fick as research supervisors. The Concordia examination sheet names F. Chalk as thesis co-supervisor and is dated December 13, 2019; the title page is dated July 2020.

notes: The linked record matches the independently catalogued doctorate in author, institution, year and title. Concordia’s faculty listing connects the advisor to that institution; Young’s thesis confirms the supervision match despite its 2020 title-page date.
